e.summary_en: This Docker Hub image **delivers the analysis environment itself for forecasting Swiss monthly mortality**, described verbatim as forecasting Swiss monthly mortality for the years 2019 to 2021 from data spanning 1901 to 2018. **Measured this round**: one hundred and fifty-seven pulls, one star, created in late April 2020 and last updated three days later, a single latest tag of about seven hundred and seventy megabytes, and support for amd64 only. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the container registry, where a model is packaged as something that can actually be run.** **Four things are worth reading: what it delivers is not a web application but a login-able RStudio session on a fixed port, so the analysis environment itself is the artefact; the description contains a runnable command with a password variable and states the login name; the build history shows four time-series forecasting packages being installed, so the method behind the result can be read off the dependencies; and the maintainer and source labels point at the base image project rather than the publisher, the same inherited-metadata shape as another image in this round.** **The image was not pulled and no session was opened this round.**
e.body:
**chmathys/swissmor**（Docker Hub 镜像）**是一个**把**瑞士月度死亡率预测**的**分析环境**整体交付的**容器镜像****——**逐字自述为**「**Forecasting Swiss monthly mortality for 2019 to 2021 based on data from 1901 to 2018**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**容器登记处：模型被打成一个可运行的镜像**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Docker Hub 登记接口与镜像配置实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它交付的是**一台可登录的 **RStudio**，**而不是**一个网页应用****——**⭐ 本次实测**其配置逐字含**端口 **`8787/tcp`**、**命令为 **`/init`****，**镜像 **770 MB、**共 **11 层**、**架构 **`amd64/linux`****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一形态**值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**在**容器登记处**里，**「**交付一个模型**」**至少有**三种做法**——**⭐ 打成**一个**网页应用**（**如**本轮另一条 **Shiny／**Streamlit 镜像）**、**打包成**一个**命令行工具**（**如**池内已收的**基准容器**）**、**或**像本条**这样**直接给你一台**装了工具链的**分析机**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**第三种**最接近**「**把研究方法交出去**」**，**而**它**也**把**复现的门槛**降到**「**会不会用 R**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 说明里逐字给出**可执行的运行命令与登录方式****——**⭐ 本次实测**其 `full_description`（**299 字符**）逐字含**：**「**Launch with the command**」**并**给出 **`docker run --name <yourchosennamehere> --rm -p 8787:8787 -e PASSWORD=<yourpasswordhere> chmathys/swissmor`**，**随后**逐字说明**「**and then go to localhost:8787**」**与**「**You can then log in with the username `rstudio` and the password**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得抄**：**⭐ 即**把**「**怎么把它跑起来**」**写成**一条**可以直接粘贴的命令**，**并**说明**必须自己设密码**（**`PASSWORD` 环境变量**）**——**⭐ 而**很多镜像**只给**一个**镜像名**。**⭐⭐ ③ 构建历史把**用了什么方法**写在依赖里****——**⭐ 本次实测**其构建历史逐字含**安装 **`tsibble`、**`feasts`、**`fable`** 与 **`urca`**（**⭐ 即**R 生态里的**时间序列与**预测工具链**，**外加**单位根与**协整检验**）**，**并**含多条 **`apt-get install` 步骤**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**说明了**容器镜像的一个好处**：**⭐ 即**方法**不再**只写在**论文里**，**而**写在**可解析的**依赖清单里**——**⭐ 读者**可以**据此**判断**「**它到底用了什么**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 标签里的**维护者与代码地址**都来自**基础镜像****——**⭐ 本次实测**其标签逐字含**「**maintainer**」为**基础镜像维护者姓名**（**⭐ 其值含邮箱**，**本词条不复制**）**、**「**org.label-schema.vcs-url**」为 **`https://github.com/rocker-org/rocker-versioned`**、**「**org.label-schema.vendor**」为 **Rocker Project**、**「**org.label-schema.license**」为 **`GPL-2.0`****。**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**这些标签**描述的是**基础镜像**，**不是**本镜像**——**⭐ 故**读者**不能**据此**判断**发布方**或**本镜像的**许可**；**⭐ 与**本轮另一条镜像**（`actuarial/shiny-chainladder`）**同一形态**，**本词条**并列记录**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[mortalitytables]]、**[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、**[[mortalityforecast]]、**[[mortalitylaws]]、**[[cee-longevity-tables]] 覆盖**死亡率表与**预测方法**、**[[pension-pro-mcp]] 覆盖**养老金数据接口**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**一国死亡率预测**的**分析环境**整体**打成镜像交付**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**，**也**未核实**其**具体方法**与**任何**已收项目**的关系****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **把**环境**当成**交付物**，**可以**把**复现门槛**降到**工具使用层面**；**② **运行说明**要给出**可粘贴的命令**与**必须设置的变量**；**③ **方法**尽量**落在**依赖清单**上**，**便于**他人**读出**；**④ **容器标签**要**看清**是**基础镜像的**、**还是**自己的**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有拉取、**没有登录**该镜像**（**未启动任何容器、**未运行任何预测**）**，**故**不主张**其**可运行**、**不主张**其**任何预测结果**、**也**不主张**其**方法选择**适当**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**登记接口、**标签列表与**镜像配置**（**含**构建历史与**标签字段**）**，**未读**其**镜像内**任何**脚本或**数据**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**镜像内**是否**含有**瑞士官方死亡率数据**及其**再分发许可**（**⭐ 说明**只提到**时间范围**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**与**瑞士官方统计机构**的任何关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**镜像自述**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**许可**落在**哪一半**（**⭐ 标签里的 **`GPL-2.0`** 来自**基础镜像**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**发布者身份**（**⭐ 只知**命名空间名**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**创建 **2020-04-27**、**最后更新 **2020-04-30**（**远在**解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**把一国死亡率预测的分析环境整体打成容器镜像交付**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该镜像**是**个人发布**，**不是**任何**官方统计或**精算意见**，**其**预测**不得**用于**任何**正式用途**而不做**独立复核**。
e.body_hk:
**chmathys/swissmor**（Docker Hub 鏡像）**是一個**把**瑞士月度死亡率預測**的**分析環境**整體交付的**容器鏡像****——**逐字自述為**「**Forecasting Swiss monthly mortality for 2019 to 2021 based on data from 1901 to 2018**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**容器登記處：模型被打成一個可運行的鏡像**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Docker Hub 登記介面與鏡像配置實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它交付的是一台可登入的 RStudio，**而不是**一個網頁應用****——**⭐ 配置逐字含端口 `8787/tcp`、**命令為 `/init`****，**鏡像 770 MB、**共 11 層、**架構 `amd64/linux`****。**⭐ 在容器登記處裡，**「**交付一個模型**」**至少有三種做法**：**打成網頁應用**、**打成命令列工具**、**或直接給你一台裝了工具鏈的分析機**；**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**第三種最接近「**把研究方法交出去**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 說明裡逐字給出可執行的運行命令與登入方式****——**其 `full_description`（**299 字符**）逐字含 Launch with the command**，**並給出 `docker run --name <yourchosennamehere> --rm -p 8787:8787 -e PASSWORD=<yourpasswordhere> chmathys/swissmor`**，**隨後逐字說明 and then go to localhost:8787** 與 **You can then log in with the username `rstudio` and the password****。**⭐ 即**把「**怎麼把它跑起來**」**寫成一條可直接粘貼的命令**，**並說明必須自己設密碼**。**⭐⭐ ③ 構建歷史把用了什麼方法寫在依賴裡****——**逐字含安裝 `tsibble`、**`feasts`、**`fable`、**`urca`**（**R 生態的時間序列與預測工具鏈，**外加單位根與協整檢驗**）**。**⭐ 方法不再只寫在論文裡**，**而寫在可解析的依賴清單裡**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 標籤裡的維護者與代碼位址都來自基礎鏡像****——**逐字含 maintainer 為**基礎鏡像維護者姓名**（**其值含郵箱**，**不複製**）**、org.label-schema.vcs-url 為 `https://github.com/rocker-org/rocker-versioned`**、**org.label-schema.vendor 為 Rocker Project**、**org.label-schema.license 為 `GPL-2.0`****。**⭐ 這些標籤描述的是基礎鏡像**，**不是本鏡像**——**⭐ 故**讀者**不能據此判斷發布方或本鏡像的許可**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[mortalitytables]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[mortalityforecast]]、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[cee-longevity-tables]]、[[pension-pro-mcp]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把一國死亡率預測的分析環境整體打成鏡像交付**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **把環境當成交付物**；**② **運行說明給出可粘貼命令與必須設置的變數**；**③ **方法盡量落在依賴清單上**；**④ **看清容器標籤是誰寫的**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有拉取、**沒有登入**該鏡像**，**不主張**其可運行或任何預測結果，**也不主張**其方法選擇適當**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀登記介面、**標籤列表與鏡像配置**，**未讀**鏡像內任何腳本或數據**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**鏡像內是否含瑞士官方死亡率數據及其再分發許可**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其與瑞士官方統計機構的任何關係**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其許可落在哪一半**（**標籤裡的 `GPL-2.0` 來自基礎鏡像**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者身份**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**創建 2020-04-27、**最後更新 2020-04-30（**遠在窗口之外**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**把一國死亡率預測的分析環境整體打成容器鏡像交付**」這一形態**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該鏡像是個人發布**，**不是**任何官方統計或精算意見**。
e.body_en:
This Docker Hub image **delivers the analysis environment itself for forecasting Swiss monthly mortality**, described verbatim as forecasting Swiss monthly mortality for the years 2019 to 2021 from data spanning 1901 to 2018. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the container registry, where a model is packaged as something that can actually be run.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry interfaces and the image configuration**: **first, what it delivers is a login-able RStudio session rather than a web application.** The configuration exposes a single port and runs the standard init as its command, in an image of about seven hundred and seventy megabytes over eleven layers on amd64 only. **That form is worth recording separately, because a container registry offers at least three ways to deliver a model: as a web application, as a command line tool, or, as here, as a machine with the toolchain already installed. For this project the third is closest to handing over a research method, and it lowers the reproduction threshold to being able to use R.** **Second, the description contains a runnable command and the login details.** It quotes a docker run command that maps the studio port, requires a password variable to be set by the user, and names the image, then tells the reader to open a local address and log in with a stated user name and the password they chose. **That is worth copying: state exactly how to start it and which variable must be set, rather than only naming an image.** **Third, the build history puts the method into the dependency list**, installing four R packages covering time series structures, feature engineering for time series, forecasting models and unit root and cointegration testing. **The method is therefore no longer only in a paper but in a parseable dependency list, so a reader can judge what was actually used.** **Fourth, the maintainer and source labels come from the base image rather than the publisher**: they name the base image maintainer, with an address this entry does not reproduce, and point at the base project repository, naming its vendor and a copyleft licence. **Those labels describe the base image, not this one, so a reader cannot infer the publisher or the licence of this artefact from them; the same inherited-metadata shape appears in another image this round, and both are recorded side by side.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover mortality tables, projection methods in several ecosystems, longevity tables and a pension data interface, **while this entry supplies the packaging of a national mortality forecasting environment as a container image. This entry makes no comparison against any of them and does not verify how its specific method relates to any pooled project.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: treat the environment as the deliverable to lower the reproduction threshold; give a paste-ready command plus the variables that must be set; keep the method in the dependency list where others can read it; and read container labels knowing which ones belong to the base.**

Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the image is an individual publication rather than any official statistical or actuarial opinion, and that its projections must not be used for any formal purpose without independent review.**
